product.name: Aurelio DeskMate 360
product.description: Compact and functional, the Aurelio DeskMate 360 offers a modular design that fits neatly into any office environment. Its layered construction features adjustable trays and a dedicated slot for pens, sticky notes, and small tech accessories. The matte black finish provides a professional look while the sturdy ABS plastic and stainless steel frame ensures durability. With a total footprint of 45 cm by 30 cm and a height of 20 cm, it occupies minimal desk space yet holds up to twelve separate compartments. The product is lightweight at 1.2 kg, making it easy to relocate between workstations. Designed for everyday use, it supports a range of stationery items and small gadgets without the need for power or external components.
